pages.text: Tobacconist includes a small advancement tree as optional milestones. Advancements do not unlock mechanics and are not required for progression; they simply mark important steps through the craft.

pages.title: Core Progression
pages.text: $(thing)A New Leaf$() — obtain any tobacco seed.$(br)$(thing)Homegrown$() — obtain a fresh tobacco leaf.$(br)$(thing)Cured to Perfection$() — obtain a cured leaf.$(br)$(thing)A Cut Above$() — obtain loose cut tobacco.

pages.title: Specialties
pages.text: $(thing)Tobacconist’s Eye$() — obtain the Spectacles.$(br)$(thing)Roll Your Own$() — make a cigarette.$(br)$(thing)Fine Taste$() — make a cigar.$(br)$(thing)Cloud Culture$() — prepare shisha tobacco.

pages.title: Exploration Goals
pages.text: $(thing)Seeds of the World$() — obtain all six tobacco seed varieties. Regional Tobacconist trades make this an exploration challenge.$(br2)$(thing)Well Equipped$() — obtain a Clay Smoking Pipe, Tobacco Pouch, Tobacco Box, and Tobacconist's Spectacles.

pages.title: Hookah Goals
pages.text: $(thing)Smoke in Style$() — obtain a Netherite Hookah.$(br2)$(thing)Hookah Collector$() — obtain every main Hookah style. Copper oxidation and waxed states are deliberately not required.

pages.title: Master Tobacconist
pages.text: The final goal remembers your progress over time. Obtain Tobacconist’s Spectacles, a wooden smoking pipe, a cigarette, a cigar, shisha tobacco, and a Tobacco Barrel. You do $(bold)not$() need to carry all six at once.

pages.title: Vapor Milestones
pages.text: $(thing)A Clear Start$() — obtain both carrier bases.$(br)$(thing)Small Batch$() — obtain usable liquid.$(br)$(thing)Recipe for Success$() — save a formula.$(br)$(thing)First Exhale$() — use a loaded pen.$(br)$(thing)Flavor Composer$() — draw a two-flavor liquid.$(br)$(thing)Just the Flavor$() — draw flavored, nicotine-free liquid.$(br)$(thing)Cloud Chaser$() — full draw at 80% VG or higher. Both vanilla and Create liquids count.
